speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They hanged the Jesuit this morning. Southwell. I did not go. …I was never going.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I should say that first. There are men who talk as if hearing a thing gave them the eyes of everyone who saw it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three men told me of it before supper and no two alike. One says he prayed for the Queen. One says the people would not let the hangman cut him down alive. They cried out, let him hang, let him be dead first. I'd like to believe that one. …I do believe that one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He was a poet. That's the thing I can't get round. They say it as though it were another offence, or an excuse. It is neither. Men have his verses by heart that would not own to it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And yesterday I stood on a scaffold in Gracechurch Street in a paper crown and swore to study three years and see no women. And they laughed. God knows they laughed. I was glad of it. I am glad of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: What is it for, then? The making. Put a thing in Latin and they call it treason. Put it in the mouth of a king three hundred years dead and they pay a penny at the door and let you go home to supper.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: …No. That's too neat. He was not hanged for a poem. He was hanged for a priest. I must not make a likeness where there's none. It is only that he was thirty-three, and I am thirty, and we both…

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was thinking of the voice. How long a voice may stay in words when the mouth is stopped. That is a fine thought, and so I distrust it a little. It makes a thing seem mended when nothing is mended.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: My father says a prayer at night that I am not supposed to know. I heard it through a wall when I was nine. I could say it now.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: …Remember: the messenger. In the last act. He comes in black among them all in their colours, and he has to say only a little. The less he says. Let him say almost nothing and let it go through them like cold.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have been holding this pen all the while. There's no ink in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I had that right. I had that right before today. …Enough.
